name: @avatark/account-ui
description: Generic, reusable account/identity UI components -- headless and prop-driven, no data fetching, no app coupling. Not wired into any application yet; this is component design only, per Phase 2's 'do not migrate applications' instruction.

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json --outDir dist --declaration --noEmit false --rewriteRelativeImportExtensions --module esnext --moduleResolution bundler && node ../../scripts/fix-dts-extensions.mjs dist
